headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI. The Cincinnati Reds also secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Abner Uribe, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Milwaukee Brewers due to a right forearm flexor strain. The Seattle Mariners have also placed Colt Emerson on the 10-day injured list with left wrist tendon inflammation. The Chicago White Sox have placed Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list with a right middle finger blister.

The Cincinnati Reds made a key roster move, securing a 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins in a tightly contested game. The Baltimore Orioles acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox, while the Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Guardians' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Rally Past White Sox 9-8**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a thrilling 9-8 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Eugenio Suárez leading the offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. Tejay Antone earned the win with 1 scoreless inning of relief, striking out 3 batters.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Marlins in Dominant 13-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a strong performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 6 runs.

top_news.title: **Mariners Shut Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in Shutout**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 3-0 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, handing the Cardinals their loss. Seiya Suzuki led the Cubs' offense, while Matthew Liberatore struggled on the mound for the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 1-0 victory over the Miami Marlins in a tightly contested game. Chase Burns was instrumental in the Reds' win, leading the team's pitching efforts.

top_news.title: **Brewers RHP Abner Uribe Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Milwaukee Brewers right-handed pitcher Abner Uribe has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right forearm flexor strain. The move is retroactive to August 11, 2026.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the 8/3 Adley Rutschman trade. The trade was made by the Boston Red Sox.
